text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The dirt Umamusume, Wonder Acute. 
Grandma-like in nature, her dream is to 
become a beacon of hope for those striving 
for a comeback.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I want to show the young folks working 
hard at my dad's boxing gym and the 
elderly doing rehab at the hospital. I 
want to show them that with steady effort, 
you can rebuild your life.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, the Trainer favored intense 
training. Though troubled by failing to 
find a compatible Umamusume, hope finally 
shone through after being accepted by her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The two of them begin their Twinkle Series 
challenge. Their goal: to catch up to 
Smart Falcon at the peak of dirt racing. 
It's time to climb this slope together.
